help:
usage: wgsextract ref [-h] <command> ...

positional arguments:
  <command>
    aadr                Explicitly fetch the hash-pinned CC0 AADR v66.p1 2M SNP panel.
    ybrowse             Explicitly install a verified, sites-only GRCh38 yBrowse snapshot.
    somalier            Explicitly fetch somalier's hash-pinned sites and 1000 Genomes sketches
                        for qc relate.
    ancestry            Fetch the hash-pinned ancestry reference for qc ancestry.
    gnomad-sv           Explicitly fetch hash-pinned gnomAD SV tables for vcf sv-freq.
    imputation          Explicitly install the hash-pinned GRCh38 imputation panel, per
                        chromosome.
    download            Download a reference FASTA from a URL (--url) to a path (--out). For
                        curated hg19/hg38/T2T genomes use 'ref library --install'.
    index               Prepare a FASTA file for use by indexing it. This is required before you
                        can align reads or call variants against it.
    dense-sa            Build wgse-bwa's optional dense suffix-array file for a FASTA (0.8 GB for
                        hs38; align reads it with --dense-suffix-array), list or delete it.
    count-ns            Calculate the percentage of 'N' (unknown) bases in a genome. Useful for
                        understanding the 'mappability' of different reference builds.
    verify              Ensure your reference genome file isn't corrupted and has all the
                        necessary companion files (indexes, dicts).
    library             Opens the interactive reference manager to help you organize and download
                        genomic data.
    status              Report reference library asset status.
    recheck             Compare the resource releases result manifests recorded with the newest:
                        from --answers FILE, or ask NCBI with --online. Downloads and reruns
                        nothing.
    test-genome         Report, install (--install) or delete (--delete) the small hg19 test
                        genome in the dataset library.
    needs               Report the reference genome, annotation data or optional tools a command
                        line needs that aren't installed, and how to install them.
    gene-map            Download or delete lightweight gene-to-coordinate mapping files
                        (hg19/hg38), enabling you to filter VCFs by gene name (e.g. BRCA1), with
                        the RefSeq transcript and exon models the genome viewer and info gene
                        show.
    cytobands           Validate installed hg19/hg38 UCSC cytobands; download missing data only
                        with --download.
    clinvar             Download official ClinVar VCF for hg19 and hg38.
    dbsnp               Download NCBI dbSNP b151 common human rsIDs (~37M SNPs, VCF + offline rsID
                        search index) for hg38 and hg19, or delete them.
    revel               Download REVEL pathogenicity scores for hg19 and hg38.
    phylop              Download UCSC's PhyloP 100-way conservation scores (~10 GB bigWig).
    gnomad              Download gnomAD population allele frequencies.
    spliceai            Download SpliceAI scores for hg38 (Ensembl, MANE SNVs); index a manual
                        hg19 download.
    alphamissense       Download AlphaMissense scores for hg19 and hg38.
    pharmgkb            Download PharmGKB annotations.
    cadd                Download CADD v1.7 deleteriousness scores (all possible SNVs plus gnomAD
                        indels, ~85 GB per build) with their tabix indexes.
    gerp                Download GERP++ conservation scores as a bigWig (hg38 from Ensembl, ~9.6
                        GB; hg19 from UCSC, ~7.6 GB).
    bootstrap           Download and initialize the reference library bootstrap (liftover chains,
                        chip templates, etc.).
    acmg-data           Download vcf acmg's 8 sources and the GFF3, check them and build fastVEP's
                        databases.
    microarray-targets  Build the genome-wide hg19 and hg38 microarray targets from the chip
                        templates, or delete them.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

global options:
  -i/--input, -o/--outdir, --genome, --ref, -t/--threads, -m/--memory, --json, --quiet, --debug,
  --config and the other global options are accepted before or after the command; 'wgsextract
  --help' lists them all.

actions.help: show this help message and exit
